eye.open: p, sy, sx = eye61Mono(KO.t, KO.p|KO.sy|KO.sx, dt), dt = t - to (Fritsch-Carlson monotone cubic; eye61Mono source below)
eye.close: q = clamp(dt / CLOSE, 0, 1)^2; p = 1 - q; sy = lerp(1, .12, q); sx = lerp(1, 1.08, q)
eye.blink: one idle blink = close at tc (0.13 s), hold shut for hold, open at to = tc + CLOSE + hold (0.54 s); the eye is wide outside blinks

idle.note: the list ends after 300 blinks (~1700 s): Unity extends it with the same generator

reveal.rule: menu cold open: shut from the start, the reference open at to0 + off[seed] (P2 entrance); a later reveal closes at tc + off*.3 then opens at to0 + off. Not used in P1a (no cold open yet).

eye.quiet: no idle blink whose [tc, end) overlaps a reveal window (tc - 1, to + 1.2) or the omen window (omenU in (-1.5, 3)); omen / apparition beats belong to the dread ladder (P5)
eye.openFactor: p is multiplied by open = max(st.open, .82) (ctxState); at the idle tier (DS.tier 2) st.open = 1 for seeds 11 / 12 / 13, so p is the schedule value
eye.rng: function rng(seed) { let a = seed >>> 0; return () => { a = a + 0x6D2B79F5 | 0; let t = Math.imul(a ^ a >>> 15, 1 | a); t = t + Math.imul(t ^ t >>> 7, 61 | t) ^ t; return ((t ^ t >>> 14) >>> 0) / 4294967296; }; }

13.pick: wide outside a blink -> frame 0; close phase (t - tc) in [0, CLOSE): k = floor((t - tc) * 60) -> frame k (k = 0 is frame 0); hold [tc + CLOSE, to): frame 8 (shut); open (t - to) in [0, OPEN): k = floor((t - to) * 60) -> frame 8 + k (k = 0 = shut); after to + OPEN -> frame 0. Frame j sits at (x, y) in the sheet, size cell.

11.pick: wide outside a blink -> frame 0; close phase (t - tc) in [0, CLOSE): k = floor((t - tc) * 60) -> frame k (k = 0 is frame 0); hold [tc + CLOSE, to): frame 8 (shut); open (t - to) in [0, OPEN): k = floor((t - to) * 60) -> frame 8 + k (k = 0 = shut); after to + OPEN -> frame 0. Frame j sits at (x, y) in the sheet, size cell.

played.src: sched_probe.mjs: EYE61.ctxState sampled at 60 Hz over 0-600 s with the breach context and the idle DS (no omen / apparition; P1a)

eye.seedsNote: v6.3 breach eyes = 11 (his, 162.4 px) + 12 / 13 (his, small, menu_v41.js:49-51); 12 is never inside the hole. The 4 cel eyes of menu.js:307 (bEyes) are not drawn in v6.3 (menu_v41.js:42 replaces menu.js:775).

torch.stoneB: Stone B alpha = flick (A at 1 under it; menu.js:654); the keystone (fx2) crossfades its A/B with the same flick (keystone_*_flick0 / _flick1)
torch.sg: sg = 0 at the idle (dread ladder only, P5)

drives.torch_pool_b0: additive weight a0 = .2 * (.8 + .3 * flick) * (1 - .6 * sg) (menu.js:658 stop 0)
drives.torch_pool_b1: additive weight a1 = .055 * (1 - .5 * sg) (menu.js:658 stop .4; constant at the idle)
drives.keystone_over_f1: alpha = flick over keystone_over_f0 at 1 (relics.js:207: Puzzle B over A at flick; menu.js:839 idleSt passes this.flick)
drives.flame: P1a: the flame layers are the frame at t (static); P1b: drawFlame as the M20 mesh (anime_menu_v6.js:289-297)
